claims: The Augusta National course record during the Masters Tournament is a 9-under-par 63.
Nick Price holds the Augusta National course record during the Masters Tournament from the 1986 third round.
Greg Norman holds the Augusta National course record during the Masters Tournament from the 1996 first round.
Lloyd Mangrum recorded 64 during the Masters Tournament in 1940.
Jordan Spieth recorded 64 during the Masters Tournament in 2015.
Jordan Spieth recorded 64 during the Masters Tournament in 2018.
Rory McIlroy recorded 64 during the Masters Tournament in 2022.
According to reports, long-time member and former Masters non-playing marker Jeff Knox holds the club record of 61 from the members' tees.
The 63 is the lowest score in Masters Tournament history.
The record of 63 in the Masters Tournament has remained untouched since 1996.
